name: Motion Webhook
author: Jane Doe
description: Posts to a webhook when motion is detected on a granted camera — nobody has to be watching.

settings.label: Webhook URL
settings.help: Where to POST on motion. Must be under the network host this extension was granted (hooks.example.com) — edit permissions.network to use a different host.

settings.label: Authorization token
settings.help: Optional. Sent as a Bearer token on the webhook request. Stored privately and never shown again.
